ld.title: One property database instead of dozens of Google Drives
ld.sub: ONEPLAN is a closed professional platform for developers and realtors: objects, unit board, prices, documents and statuses in one system. One link instead of folders.
ld.who1_d: Stock, unit board, prices and documents under control. Public showcase with one link.
ld.who2_d: One database for the team, role-based access, change history.
ld.who3_d: Direct closed exchange of objects, no long chain of intermediaries.
ld.f1_d: Statuses, prices, layouts, duplexes and commercial — like on paper, but live.
ld.f2_d: Photos, video, location, documents, construction diary and statuses in one place.
ld.f3_d: A clean object page by link for clients, always up to date.
ld.f4_d: Companies, employees, permissions. Hidden and confidential objects.
ld.form_sub: Leave your contacts — we will onboard you to the pilot. It is free.
ld.f_consent: I agree to data processing for feedback
ld.free_note: ONEPLAN is currently free during the pilot period.

lg.sub: ONEPLAN platform agreements and policies. Current versions and dates.
lg.disclaimer: Current versions of the platform documents. When terms change, a new version is published with a new date.
lg.cookie_text: We use cookies to run the platform.

co.title: Companies & access
co.sub: Developers, their teams and access rights
co.nc_hint: The administrator gets an invite email and adds their own team.
co.co_vis_desc: A hidden company and all its projects are removed from the cabinet. Data is kept — restore anytime.
co.plat_hint: Not shown in developers’ team lists — works on projects behind the scenes. Visible only to you (super-admin).
co.arch_desc: Hidden projects are removed from the main list and the public page. Hide for any reason — not only when completed.
co.nu_pass_hint: The user receives their login and this password by email.
co.people_sub: All people in the system and their access
co.nu_companies_hint: Editors and managers can work with several developers at once.
co.access_desc: Platform subscription term. When it expires, access to all company projects closes.
co.cp_desc: Filled in manually. Shown to clients on the developer public page.

lv_edit_hint: Edit mode: change price and status right in the row; the pencil or a row click opens the full card
lv_edit_hint_cards: Edit mode: click a card to edit the unit
fp_real_hint: Units are colored by status — click opens the card
fp_hint: Units are marked on the plan and colored by status — click to open the card. In trace mode you draw areas over your drawing.
grid_desc: Grid framework: sections, floors, unit numbers. Numbers separated by spaces, a new line is a new floor. "1*" is a commercial unit.
grid_ex: Example: "15 16 17 18 19 1*" — 1* is a commercial unit on the floor. Cell merging is in edit mode.
io_import_desc: Upload an Excel or CSV file — unit price, status and area are updated by number. The board structure (floors, numbers, cell layout) stays unchanged.
io_fields: File columns: ID · Block · Floor · Number · Rooms · Area · Price · Status. Price, status, area and rooms are updated — layout and duplexes stay as they are.
io_reco: We recommend exporting the current data to Excel first, editing it in that same file, and uploading it back. Unit numbers will match exactly and the risk of import errors is minimized.
io_preview_sub: Review the changes before applying — only the listed units will be updated.
io_preview_err: Could not read the file. Make sure it is an Excel or CSV with Number, Price and Status columns.
io_preview_none: No changes found — the file matches the current data.

pb.title: Object publication
pb.desc: Where to show the object. By default — only in the closed professional ONEPLAN network.
pb.closed_d: Visible only to verified professionals. Not indexed by search engines, not published on external sites.
pb.pub_d: Plus publication on one-team.pro and akdeniz.ru.
pb.beyan: I confirm I hold the owner/representative authority to advertise this object publicly. Responsibility for authority lies with the person who posts it.
pb.eids_hint: For closed exchange between realtors EİDS is usually not required — the owner has already authorized the agent. This field is only for the public showcase.

fs_desc: How floors are shown for this project. Data stays the same — only the display changes.
cur_convert:
Convert all unit prices from {from} to {to} at 1 {from} = {rate} {to}?

«Cancel» keeps the numbers and only changes the currency symbol.
cur_hint: Prices are stored in the project currency and shown as entered. When switching currency you can convert them at the current rate.
set_colors_desc: Custom status colors for this project.
set_feats_desc: Catalog labels. Assigned to units in the unit dialog.
set_feat_order_hint: Drag chips to reorder — unit cards show features in this order.
set_plans_desc: Upload layouts linked to units (+ extra images for duplex units / villas).
pl_sub: The image is linked to a type — every unit of that type shows it in its card. A unit-specific layout can be replaced inside the unit.
pl_multi_hint: Multiple images allowed: plan, duplex 2nd-floor plan, 3D view. The first one is the main image in the unit card.
pt_mirror_hint: Same area but different inside, or mirrored — create a separate type (Tip A / Tip A-R) and pick it in the unit card.
pt_pick_hint: Add another variant for the same m² in the “Layouts” section.
pt_no_plan: no plan: units are not traced on a floor plan
unit_photos_need_type: Set the number of rooms for the unit first
unit_photos_hint: Real photos or renders. Shown for every unit of this layout type, after the floor plan. Drag to reorder; saved immediately. You can also drop image files here.
pt_mirror_none: No mirrored types found — outlines on floor plans are needed

pl.inline: By using ONEPLAN you accept the platform's current documents.
pl.title: Privacy & documents
pl.sub: Accepted versions, consents and your rights
pl.marketing_d: Email/SMS about news and offers. Does not affect system notifications.
pl.del_note: Mandatory accounting and evidentiary records may be kept longer by law.

pass_hint: At least 6 characters: latin letters, one digit, uppercase, lowercase and a symbol.

wz.plans_hint: Floor plans and unit layouts — the board is built from them.
wz.drop_plans_sub: PDF, PNG, DWG — one per floor / section
wz.drop_layouts_sub: PNG, JPG — linked to types and numbers
wz.docs_hint: Materials for clients and legal documents.
wz.cat_price_sub: CSV, XLSX, PDF — import into the board
wz.comm_q: Does the project have commercial units?
wz.comm_hint: Shops, offices, cafes on the ground floors (TİCARİ folder).
wz.review_sub: Everything that used to live in Google Drive folders is now in a single project.

hub.desc: One link instead of Google Drive folders — always up to date for clients and partners.
hub.hidden_msg: The developer has temporarily hidden this project

ed.hint: The grid IS the board: add floors and units, click a cell to edit — clients see the result instantly.
ed.num_from_hint: First unit number of this block (hand-typed numbers are kept)
ed.add_floor_below_hint: Adds a floor under the lowest one (basement). Other unit numbers stay unchanged — the new tile has a manual number.

mk.title: Create units
mk.sub: The board builds itself — pick a method
mk.paste_hint: Copy rows straight from Excel / Google Sheets — number, floor, type, area, price, status in any order. Columns are detected automatically.
mk.gen_hint: An empty grid is created first — just floors and numbered slots. Fill in each unit's type, area and price later by clicking its cell — edit mode turns on automatically.
mk.gen_pf: Units per floor — adjust where it differs
mk.add_note: New units will be added to the current board
mk.replace_warn: Current units of this project will be replaced
mk.empty_sub: Build the board in a minute: paste a price list from Excel or generate a grid — anyone can do it.
mk.preview_note: First 6 of {n} shown — all will be created
mk.keep_hint: Units with matching numbers are updated (rooms, m², price, status); duplexes, tile width and layout are kept. New numbers are added.

pub.live_now: Live stream from the construction site

edp.live_sub: Web-camera or live broadcast link (YouTube Live, Vimeo). Shown as a LIVE button at the top of the project while streaming.
edp.del_hint: The project and its public page will become unavailable
edp.docs_hint: click a status to change it
edp.ai_note: Translated by AI — edit manually if needed
edp.live_hint: Live stream from the site · click to toggle
edp.drophint: Click "Add photo" to pick files from your computer (drag & drop works in the final product)
edp.ai_empty: Fill in the description in Russian (or another language) first
edp.ai_nokey: AI translation is not configured: add ANTHROPIC_API_KEY to .env.local and restart the server
edp.ai_nosession: Sign in to use AI translation

dev.files_hint: files are downloadable on the public page
dev.reports_hint: photos & videos from the site — the stage is set above

geo.link_ph: Paste a Google Maps, Yandex Maps, Apple Maps or 2GIS link
geo.link_hint: Coordinates and address are detected from the link automatically
geo.short_link: Could not get coordinates from the short link — open it in a browser and copy the full address from the address bar.
geo.bad_link: No coordinates found in the link
geo.geocode_fail: Could not detect the address for this point — enter it manually
geo.no_coords: Enter coordinates or paste a map link
geo.map_hint: Click the map or drag the marker — the address is resolved from the point automatically
geo.manual_keep: A manually typed address is kept: the one found for the point is shown below, the button applies it

dx.upload_wait: Wait until the files finish uploading
dx.upload_retry: Upload failed — remove the file and add it again

prof_pass_short: Password is too short — at least 6 characters

board.width_hint: Stretch the unit across 2–3 cells — or drag the right edge of the tile on the board.
board.band_hint: Two-row floor: “Outer” faces the street, “Courtyard” is the inner row. A second line appears on every floor.

set_plans_soon: Plan-type images modal arrives with the board

fp.hint_trace: Click the plan to place outline points. Enter, double-click or clicking the first point closes the outline; Esc cancels; Backspace removes the last point. Click an outline to select it — vertices can be dragged.
fp.empty_sub: Upload the floor plan image (PNG or JPG) — trace the units by hand or let AI do a draft.
fp.pdf_hint: Could not read the PDF — save the plan as an image (PNG/JPG) and upload it
fp.all_mapped: All units on this floor are marked
fp.confirm_remove: Delete this floor plan together with its outlines?
fp.img_dead: Plan image unavailable (saved in demo mode until reload) — upload it again
fp.ai_done: AI traced {n} of {m} units — review the outlines in trace mode
fp.ai_none: AI found none of the floor's units on the plan
fp.ai_no_key: AI tracing unavailable: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is not set
fp.ai_bad: AI did not answer with JSON — try again
fp.ai_no_units: No units on this floor to trace
fp.ai_confirm: AI proposed outlines for {n} units that already have one. Replace them?
fp.ai_too_big: Image is too large for AI (max 4.5 MB)
fp.ai_fetch_err: Could not download the plan image
fp.copy_confirm: Replace this floor's plan and contours with a copy from another floor?
fp.copied: Copied: contours bound to {n} of {m} units on this floor — review and adjust
fp.click_hint: Click the unit to open its card
fp.other_lvl_missing: {lvl} — floor {f} is not traced, the type will get one image only
fp.tidy_nomap: Plan image can't be analysed (CORS) — contour is aligned without snapping to walls
fp.crop_err: Could not cut the layout from the plan
fp.auto_imgs_hint: “From plan” images are cut automatically along the unit outline on the floor plan and removed together with the outline. Add other images manually.
fp.autotidy_hint: Points snap to walls, the contour is aligned when closed. Hold Shift to place a point without snapping
fp.ai_all_done: All units of this floor are already traced — confirm replacement to redo the markup
fp.zoom_hint: Plan zoom: for small units on a whole-building sheet
fp.walls_none: Could not snap to walls: outlines don’t match the drawing. Works on rendered plans with black walls
fp.walls_noareas: Outline the apartments first (even roughly) or run AI marking
fp.walls_hint: Trace apartments precisely along the drawing’s walls, starting from the current outlines
fp.duplex_tagged: duplexes by stairs on the plan: {n}

imp.title: New project from files
imp.sub: Upload the price list and floor plans — the unit grid, layouts and types are built automatically
imp.p_drop_sub: Excel, CSV, PDF, photo or scan — in whatever form you have it
imp.p_paste: …or paste the table from Excel as text
imp.p_paste_ph: Copy the price rows and paste them here
imp.p_ai: AI is reading the price list, this can take up to a minute…
imp.p_replace_sub: Several files — one per block — can be uploaded at once
imp.p_empty: No units found in the file. Try another file or paste the table as text.
imp.p_nokey: AI reading is unavailable: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is not set. Upload Excel/CSV or paste the table as text.
imp.p_toobig: The file is too large to read (max 20 MB)
imp.p_err: Could not read the price list
imp.p_trunc: The price list is very long — only part of the rows were read. Check the count.
imp.p_cur: Prices are in {c} — project currency set automatically
imp.f_drop_sub: A whole PDF (all sheets) or images. You can skip this step and add plans later.
imp.f_none: Floors not determined — the sheet will not be used
imp.f_attic_hint: This block's price list has no duplexes, so the sheet is not used. Mark duplexes in the grid and upload the sheet to their floor later.
imp.f_attic_res: Duplex upper level — {f}: the duplexes of that floor will also be marked on this sheet.
imp.f_skip: Plans are optional — the project can be built with the grid only.
imp.b_hint: Project «{name}» will be created: {n} units, floor plans: {p}. This takes from a few seconds to a couple of minutes.
imp.b_ai_skip: AI markup unavailable ({r}) — units can be traced manually
imp.k_ok: No issues — the project is complete
imp.k_hint: Unit outlines were placed by AI as a draft — check them in «Layouts → Floor plan».
imp.i_notTraced: Not traced on the floor plan
imp.i_h_noType: Open the unit and choose rooms
imp.i_h_noArea: Without area the unit will not join its layout type
imp.i_h_noPrice: Buyers will see the unit without a price
imp.i_h_notTraced: Trace the unit on the plan to get its layout
imp.i_h_floorNoPlan: Upload a plan or copy it from another floor
imp.i_h_typeNoImage: Trace units of this type or add photos
imp.b_ai_wait: usually 2–3 minutes, keep this tab open
imp.f_blocks_hint: If the sheet shows several blocks at once, select all of them
imp.f_nofloor: Floor {f} is not in the price list of the selected blocks — pick a floor above or check floors in the price list
imp.p_gap: The price list has a ground floor (Z) but no floor 1 — floor 2 comes right after Z. If the lowest floor is called the first in the document, fix it with one click.
imp.f_cut: boundary between blocks — drag the slider
imp.f_cut_hint: The sheet is cut along this line: each block gets its own part (larger, without other blocks' units)

prof_photo_hint: JPG or PNG up to 5 MB. Colleagues and clients see the photo.
prof_mail_note: The e-mail is changed by the platform administrator
prof_photo_type: Please choose a JPG or PNG image
tfa_sub: Sign-in is confirmed with a Google Authenticator code
tfa_bad: Wrong code — check the time on your phone and try again
tfa_qr: Scan the QR code in Google Authenticator or enter the key manually, then type the code from the app.
tfa_relogin: Sign in again and confirm with a code to do this
